tools.name: search_corpus
tools.description: BM25 full-text search over indexed repository chunks with default-on hybrid dense reranking. Supports optional query classification for classification-aware alpha and family filter selection. If embeddings are cold or model-only, the tool returns BM25 results with dense_state, dense_degraded, and dense_reason; run npm run index:prewarm to warm dense search. When use_rerank is true, cross-encoder re-ranking is applied to the top hybrid candidates; if the reranker is cold or model-only, the response includes rerank_degraded, rerank_state, and rerank_reason.

use_dense.description: Defaults to true. Set false for BM25-only search; run npm run index:prewarm when dense_state reports cold or model-only.

alpha.description: BM25/dense blend weight (0 = BM25 only, 1 = dense only). When omitted and query_class is not specified, classification determines alpha automatically.

query_class.description: Override query classification for routing. When provided, alpha and family are set from the routing table unless explicitly overridden.

classification_hints.description: Optional overrides for classification-derived alpha and family. When provided, these take precedence over automatic classification.

family.description: Override family filter from classification routing.

use_rerank.description: Defaults to false. Set true to apply cross-encoder re-ranking to the top hybrid candidates after dense retrieval; if the reranker is cold or model-only, the response includes rerank_degraded=true.

rerank_candidates_count.description: Number of hybrid candidates to re-rank with the cross-encoder (default: 50). Ignored when use_rerank is false.

expand_query.description: Enable query expansion before search. true for full expansion (domain associations + embedding synonyms), "domain-only" for domain associations only, false (default) for no expansion.

compact.description: When true, return only essential fields and truncate text snippets to a compact threshold.

metadata.description: Optional metadata filter with a structured predicate tree. Supports eq, neq, in, not_in, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, is_null, is_not_null, and, or, and not.

filter.description: Structured filter predicate tree applied to chunk metadata columns.

use_rerank.description: Whether cross-encoder re-ranking was applied to the results.

rerank_candidates_count.description: Number of hybrid candidates sent to the cross-encoder for re-ranking.

rerank_degraded.description: True when use_rerank was requested but the reranker was cold or model-only, so results are not re-ranked.

rerank_state.description: Reranker readiness state: cold, model-only, or warm.

rerank_reason.description: Human-readable degradation reason when cross-encoder re-ranking fell back; run npm run index:prewarm:reranker.

expansion.description: Query expansion metadata. Present when expand_query is enabled.

degraded.description: True when expansion degraded (e.g., ONNX model unavailable).

reason.description: Reason when expansion was not applied or degraded.

query_class.description: Detected or specified query classification: simple_lookup, cross_boundary, multi_hop, exploratory, code_specific, or plan_specific.

confidence.description: Classification confidence (0–1). Higher is more confident.

classification_fallback.description: True when classification confidence was below the degradation threshold and the system fell back to simple_lookup with alpha 0.50.

dense_degraded.description: True when default-on or requested dense search degraded to BM25 because embeddings were cold or model-only.

dense_state.description: Dense-readiness provenance emitted on default-on dense responses: cold, model-only, or warm.

dense_reason.description: Human-readable degradation reason when dense search falls back to BM25; operators should run npm run index:prewarm.

response_tokens.description: Estimated tokens consumed by the response text snippets.

tools.name: search_context
tools.description: Search the corpus and assemble a token-bounded context window. Combines hybrid retrieval with chunk enrichment, deduplication, ordering, budget enforcement, and stitching. Returns the assembled context plus provenance metadata including chunk count, token count, tier counts, and dense-search health.

limit.description: Maximum number of corpus results to retrieve (default 5).

budget.description: Token budget for the assembled context (default 1024).

include_metadata.description: When true, include the full v2 semantic metadata object for each chunk in the results array.

compact.description: When true, return only essential per-chunk fields and truncate the assembled context to a compact threshold.

read_top_result.description: When true, include the full text of the top-ranked result inline in the response, avoiding a separate load_chunk call.

dedup_strategy.description: Deduplication strategy: exact (hash-based collapse) or cosine (embedding similarity collapse).

context_budget_consumed.description: Tokens consumed from the assembled context budget.

top_result.description: Full text and provenance of the top-ranked result, present when read_top_result is true.

follow_up_refs.description: Suggested next tool calls, such as load_chunk for the top result or a related search_advanced query.

tools.name: search_advanced
tools.description: Full-pipeline advanced corpus search: classify the query, optionally expand it, retrieve hybrid results, re-rank, and optionally assemble an agent-ready context window. Returns pipeline metadata (query_class, alpha, expand_query, use_rerank, use_dense, dense_state, rerank_state, expansion) alongside results.

query_class.description: Optional query-class override. When omitted the query is classified automatically.

alpha.description: BM25/dense blend weight (0 = BM25 only, 1 = dense only).

use_dense.description: Enable hybrid dense reranking when the index is warm.

use_rerank.description: Enable cross-encoder re-ranking. Defaults are query-class dependent.

expand_query.description: Enable query expansion. Defaults are query-class dependent.

rerank_candidates_count.description: Number of hybrid candidates to re-rank with the cross-encoder (default: 10).

compact.description: When true, return only essential fields and truncate text snippets to a compact threshold.

read_top_result.description: When true, include the full text of the top-ranked result inline in the response, avoiding a separate load_chunk call.

context_budget.description: When provided, assemble a token-bounded context window from the retrieved results.

explain_ranking.description: When true, every result includes a ranking_explanation object showing BM25, dense, rerank, and final scores plus a short reason.

include_code_only.description: When true, suppress generated README families and focus on code-source results. Defaults to true for the code_specific query class.

auto_fallback.description: When true, run a native substring fallback and merge its results when the primary pipeline is empty or low-confidence.

rerank_candidates_count.description: Number of hybrid candidates selected for cross-encoder reranking.

response_tokens.description: Estimated tokens consumed by the response text snippets.

top_result.description: Full text and provenance of the top-ranked result, present when read_top_result is true.

follow_up_refs.description: Suggested next tool calls, such as load_chunk for the top result or a related search_advanced query.

fallback.description: Present when auto_fallback was triggered. Contains the merged fallback results that were used to populate the response.

tools.name: load_chunk
tools.description: Load one indexed corpus chunk by numeric chunk ID. Returns v2 semantic metadata including depth, parent_chunk_id, context_header, symbol_name, signature_text, jsdoc_text, export_type, and module_path.

query.description: Optional originating query for click correlation and deduplication.

depth.description: Chunk depth: 0 for top-level, 1 for sub-chunks within a parent.

parent_chunk_id.description: Database ID of the parent chunk for depth-1 sub-chunks, or null for depth-0.

context_header.description: Agent-facing context header, e.g. "[src/file.ts > ClassName > methodName]"

symbol_name.description: Exported symbol name for TypeScript chunks.

signature_text.description: Full signature text for TypeScript symbols.

jsdoc_text.description: JSDoc summary text for the symbol.

module_path.description: Re-export target module path, or null.

tools.name: load_parent_chunk
tools.description: Load the parent chunk for a given depth-1 sub-chunk by its numeric chunk ID. Returns the full parent chunk descriptor with v2 semantic metadata.

chunk_id.description: Chunk ID of a depth-1 sub-chunk whose parent to load.

tools.name: load_document
tools.description: Load all ordered chunks for one indexed repository path. Returns v2 semantic metadata per chunk plus a hierarchy summary (depth_0_count, depth_1_count, has_sub_chunks).

hierarchy.description: Summary of chunk depth distribution within this document.

depth_1_count.description: Number of sub-chunks (depth-1) within parent chunks.

has_sub_chunks.description: True when the document contains depth-1 sub-chunks.

tools.name: freshness_check
tools.description: Compare indexed document freshness proofs with current filesystem metadata.

tools.name: index_stats
tools.description: Return corpus row counts, family counts, and last indexed timestamp. When include_metadata_coverage is true, also returns per-column metadata coverage statistics for chunks and documents.

include_metadata_coverage.description: When true, compute metadata column coverage for chunks and documents.

tools.name: ann_build_index
tools.description: Build or refresh the Approximate-Nearest-Neighbor (ANN) index for dense corpus search. Creates a DiskANN vector index using libsql_vector_idx on chunks.embedding with cosine metric.

force.description: Override the automatically selected ANN strategy.

validate_recall.description: When true, validate index recall against brute-force results (reserved for future validation).

tools.name: list_families
tools.description: List indexed document families with document and chunk counts.

tools.name: scan_code_quality
tools.description: Scan exported TypeScript symbols for missing or weak JSDoc and high cyclomatic complexity.

tools.name: traverse_graph
tools.description: Traverse the entity/relationship graph from seed entities, following specified relationship types for a configurable number of hops. Returns discovered entities, relationships, and associated chunk_ids for context expansion.

seed_names.description: Qualified names or partial names of seed entities to start traversal from.

seed_query.description: Free-text query to discover seed entities via name/qualified_name search.

relationship_types.description: Relationship types to follow during traversal.

entity_types.description: Entity types to include in results.

max_hops.description: Maximum number of hops from seed entities. Default: 2, min: 1, max: 4.

max_results.description: Maximum number of entities to return. Default: 20, max: 50.

tools.name: expand_query
tools.description: Expand a search query using domain associations and embedding-based synonym discovery. Returns expanded terms, an OR-expanded BM25 query, and expansion metadata. Supports classification-aware expansion behavior (simple_lookup=false, code_specific/plan_specific=domain-only, cross_boundary/multi_hop/exploratory=full).

expand_query.description: Enable query expansion. true for full expansion (domain associations + embedding synonyms), "domain-only" for domain associations only, false (default) for no expansion.

query_class.description: Override query classification for expansion behavior. When provided, expansion behavior is determined by expansionBehaviorForClass().

expanded_terms.description: Array of expanded term objects with original, expanded, source, confidence, similarity, relevanceScore, and type fields.

bm25_query.description: OR-expanded FTS5 query string, or null if no expansion applied.

reason.description: Reason when expansion was not applied or degraded.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Submit an explicit feedback signal for a corpus chunk. Records reference, positive, or negative events and recomputes the chunk feedback boost score.

chunk_id.description: Numeric chunk identifier that received the feedback.

signal_type.description: Feedback signal type: reference (cited), positive (helpful), negative (not helpful), or irrelevant.

signal_strength.description: Optional signal strength override. Falls back to class defaults when omitted.

context.description: Optional free-text context explaining the feedback (truncated to 500 characters).

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier that submitted the feedback.

recorded.description: True when the event was persisted.

feedback_boost_after.description: Recomputed feedback boost score after recording the event.

feedback_score.description: Aggregate feedback score for the chunk.

total_signals.description: Total number of feedback signals for the chunk.

feedback_boost.description: Feedback boost applied to future rankings.

tools.name: parallel_search
tools.description: Run multiple corpus SQL queries concurrently and merge results via Reciprocal Ranked Fusion (RRF). Respects the TURSO_CONCURRENCY env var to limit in-flight requests (default 20). Graceful degradation: surviving query results are returned when individual queries fail.

queries.description: Array of query objects to run concurrently. Each query has a `sql` string and optional `args` array.

fusion.description: Fusion strategy for merging multi-query results. "rrf" uses Reciprocal Ranked Fusion (rank-based); "alpha" uses score-based weighted blend of normalized scores.

limit.description: Maximum number of merged results to return. When omitted, all merged results are returned.

use_dense.description: When true, include dense (embedding) query results in the parallel batch alongside BM25 queries. When false, only the provided queries are executed.

results.description: Merged results from all successful queries, sorted by descending RRF score.

errors.description: Per-query failure descriptors when individual queries fail. Omitted when all queries succeed.

tools.name: multi_hop_search
tools.description: Multi-hop vector→graph→vector composition search. Hop 1: vector_top_k finds seed chunks from a query embedding. Hop 2: entities JOIN edges traverses the graph from seed chunk_ids. Hop 3: vector_top_k scoped to neighbor chunk_ids finds related chunks. Combined ranking: vector_distance × graph_proximity.

query.description: Free-text query for the initial vector seed search.

max_hops.description: Maximum number of hops. 1 = vector seed only, 2 = +graph traversal, 3 = +scoped vector search. Must be an integer between 1 and 3.

relationship_types.description: Relationship types to follow during graph traversal (hop 2).

entity_types.description: Entity types to include in graph traversal results (hop 2).

limit.description: Maximum number of combined results to return.

seed_chunks.description: Seed chunks from hop 1 vector search.

entities.description: Entities discovered during hop 2 graph traversal.

results.description: Combined results sorted by combined_score (vector_distance × graph_proximity) descending.

tools.name: turso_branch
tools.description: Create or delete a branch of a Turso database via the Turso Platform API (api.turso.tech). Branch creation POSTs with a seed block so index changes can be tested in isolation without affecting the production database. Branch cleanup (delete) issues a DELETE to the same Platform API.

branch_name.description: Name of the branch to create or delete. Required for both create and delete actions.

action.description: Whether to create (POST with seed) or delete (DELETE) the branch. Defaults to "create".

tools.name: turso_pitr
tools.description: Create a Turso database from a timestamp via the Turso Platform API (api.turso.tech) for point-in-time recovery. POSTs with a seed block of type "timestamp" that carries the recovery timestamp and source database name. Returns the recovered database name, hostname, and raw API response.

database_name.description: Name of the recovered database to create. Required.

source_database_name.description: Source database to recover from (the database whose PITR retention window applies).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp within the PITR retention window of the source database.
